identity.name: Waxed Fletching
identity.summary: Ochre feathers stacked beneath a dark beeswax cake.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 2 damage to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
identity.lore: Rain stopped spoiling the hunt after this small invention.

effects.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 2 damage to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Pairs with the permanent Bowmaster quiver and other different quiver attachments; normal bows receive no implicit bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Grave Bandage, Feather Keeper into Waxed Fletching.
